title: bus.maintenance.pr v1
description: Emitted by tools/maintenance-train/finalize.sh the moment a maintenance-train worker's PR is opened. One event per PR (not per commit, not per retry). The board's in-review lane already lights up from generic hearth-loom PR-lifecycle streams (see adapters/board/board.py PR_STREAMS); this channel is the maintenance-train-specific signal for consumers that only care about automated chore/CI-red/dependabot PRs, not every PR on the bus.

bead_id.description: The beads_global bead this PR resolves, e.g. 'nervous-bus-m7xr'.

repo.description: Target repo short name (matches tools/maintenance-train/repo_config.py keys), e.g. 'deer-flow'.

title.description: The bead title (also used verbatim as the PR title's suffix, '[maint] <bead-id>: <title>').
